resolution: All 4 findings reproduced and fixed; 12/12 repo gates green; tray gate PASS; negative suite 4/4.

findings.claim: With --fast the gate exited 0 printing 'PASS — every rendered template builds' while tray.rs.template did not compile — a green result over the exact defect class the gate exists to catch.
findings.evidence: Reproduced: reintroduced E0596 in a scratch copy, ran with --fast → rc=0 and the PASS line. The skip branch printed a prose warning but never set FAILURES, and --fast is a documented first-class mode the negative suite itself invokes.
findings.status: REPRODUCED — FIXED. --fast now sets SKIPPED and exits 2 with 'PARTIAL — health-aggregator only; tray.rs was NOT built ... this is not a pass'. A prose warning is not a machine-readable signal; the exit code is. This is the third instance in this phase of a checker that could not fail.

findings.claim: The --fast negative run reported 'all 3 checks behaved correctly' while its positive control ran in the same blind mode and the only fixture guarding the shipped defect was skipped.
findings.evidence: The control asserted rc==0, which --fast always returned; the E0596 fixture is skipped under --fast. A fast run could not distinguish a working gate from one incapable of failing.
findings.status: REPRODUCED — FIXED. The control now asserts the mode's real contract (rc==2 PARTIAL in fast mode, rc==0 otherwise), expect_fail rejects a PARTIAL masquerading as a detection, and the closing line reads '(FAST — the tray.rs fixture was NOT run; this is not full coverage)'.

findings.claim: The suite depended on `timeout`, absent from stock macOS — the documented target platform — so every fixture would fail as a false RED blaming the templates.
findings.evidence: `command -v timeout` resolves only to /opt/homebrew/bin/timeout (coreutils). Without it, rc=127 with empty output makes the positive control abort with 'the gate does not pass on the UNBROKEN templates'.
findings.status: REPRODUCED — FIXED. Falls back to gtimeout and exits 1 with a named cause when neither exists.

findings.claim: The tray-templates elif was inserted mid-way through the generator-purity explanatory comment, orphaning ~15 lines of prose from the branch they document.
findings.evidence: Lines describing generator-purity now precede the tray-templates branch. Behavior unaffected.
findings.status: REPRODUCED — FIXED. The branch was moved above the generator-purity banner; routing, the unknown-mode guard (rc=2), generator-purity and `all` all re-verified.
